scenes.text: A productive day starts the night before.
scenes.visual_hint: person setting an alarm clock on a bedside table at night

scenes.text: Wake up at the same time every morning, even on weekends.
Drink a full glass of water before you reach for your phone.
scenes.visual_hint: pouring water into a glass in a bright kitchen

scenes.text: Spend ten minutes moving your body, with a short walk or some stretching.
scenes.visual_hint: woman stretching on a yoga mat in a park

scenes.text: Then write down the three most important tasks for the day.
scenes.visual_hint: hand writing a to-do list in a notebook

scenes.text: Start with the hardest one, while your mind is still fresh.
scenes.visual_hint: focused person working at a desk with a laptop
